harness.scope: Implementation and reproducibility limitations, kept separate from Git reconciliation and from claim labels/outcomes. Frozen tasks and runner are unchanged.

limitations.observation: Task selection uses the live main branch and --since=180.days, then a seeded commit-hash order and a per-repository cap (CLI default 20).
limitations.implication: The seed alone cannot reproduce selection at a later date or after main changes. This study must retain its exact frozen 30-task manifest and effective invocation; rerunning the selector is not an exact replay.
limitations.actual_study_action: Retain the frozen manifest; no reselection or task substitution was performed.

limitations.observation: taskText strips any trailing line matching ^[A-Za-z-]+: .+, including an ordinary one-line conventional commit subject. A synthetic fix: preserve command result when the child exits unsuccessfully becomes an empty string. The qualification screen then rejects messages shorter than 40 characters.
limitations.implication: Eligible-task selection and prompt text depend on this broader-than-trailers behavior. The effect on candidate inclusion has not been recomputed or quantified.
limitations.actual_study_action: Preserve frozen selection and prompt text; document behavior. Restrict trailer stripping only in future, versioned selection code.

limitations.observation: A missing terminal result throws before a run record is written. A recorded zero-turn error is skipped on resumption by task:model identity. The runner has no bounded one-time startup retry ledger.
limitations.implication: The planned startup retry is not implemented. No claim is made that this caused an observed failure in the fixed dataset.
limitations.actual_study_action: No runner alteration or benchmark rerun; future execution needs an explicit bounded attempt ledger.

git_reconciliation.conclusion: The saved truth is not contradicted by this bounded review, but its original Git command success cannot be independently confirmed. All final main-run worktrees and local bare remotes were deleted after measurement. All 60 saved dirty_paths arrays are empty, so no collapsed saved directory can be expanded or supplies a demonstrated omission. The runner did not preserve the individual Git probe exits. The reviewed transcript error candidates do not establish a failure of any original harness Git probe. Zero counter values are retained as recorded, with unresolved measurement-status ambiguity, not reclassified as failures.
